issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 04 requests the number (Anzahl) of swimming pools in municipalities with more than 1000 female inhabitants, but the solution query returns the names of the Schwimmbad rows instead of an aggregated count. This mismatch between the expected output type (a single count) and the solution's result set (multiple names) will make the solution incorrect for the stated task and confuse students or automated tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the solution query to return a count instead of individual names. For example, replace the first SELECT line with: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Schwimmbad, Gemeinde WHERE Gemeinde.schluessel = Schwimmbad.gemeindeschluessel AND Gemeinde.einwohner_w > 1000; This aligns the solution with the task requirement to output the number of swimming pools.
